يبتدروا (form VIII)
# يَبْتَدِرُوا (yabtadirū) /jab.ta.di.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
# يُبْتَدَرُوا (yubtadarū) /jub.ta.da.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
